name: dyn08_v2
notes: DYN-08 v2 (EXP-036 corrected rerun), decision D-029, registered BEFORE any v2 run. Extends configs/dyn08.json (v1, RUN-0099, F-069, stopped at stop rules 4.5(a),(b)) with: control (a') worst-surrogate-risk layout, control (b') 10 vs 10 random layouts with a two-level layout x episode bootstrap, two-level primary dyn_opt-vs-random, bin-0 fill for CT/CAUSAL, model-error CIs, fresh test/validation seeds. Everything else unchanged. Post-hoc-corrected confirmatory rerun, NOT a rescue of v1. Disclosure: v1 test episodes were viewed; wind windows and design layouts are not fresh, only episodes/noise are.

seeds.note: v2 only (RESERVED_BY in dynamic_belauri.py): test 44000-44191, validation 45000-45047. Spent v1 ranges 43000-43191, 46000-46047, 49000+ are in USED_SEEDS. wind_selection/design_layouts/pool_layouts feed seeded RNG streams only (control (b') groups use design-layout replicate indices 100-109 and 200-209; the primary random layouts 0-9 are unchanged from v1). dev/smoke seeds >= 49000 never enter a claim.

hp_grid.note: exponents (start, stop inclusive, step) of 10**e; M0/M1: alpha_m; M2: alpha_2 x {0, 10**beta_exp}; tuned on the SPREAD layout per (k, noise) on validation episodes only

model_error.note: truth perturbed, inverse nominal, layouts and hyperparameters frozen; run on a SUBSET of the test episodes (first seed of each wind x family); the matched condition is the test stage's own rows for those episodes. rot5/10/20 mirror DYN-07 (F-049); mesh250 = truth on the 250 m padded level block-averaged onto 500 m (a proxy for numerical error, not a mesh-adequacy test, F-048 void).

cost.unit: core-hours = single-core wall seconds / 3600. Constants below were measured on the local WSL2 workstation (16 logical CPUs) on 2026-10-15 UNDER LOAD (load average 13: another job occupied ~13 CPUs), so they are about 2x the lightly-loaded values (5.5 s per dt-100 solve measured earlier in the session). Cluster-core speed is NOT measured: first cluster action = `--stage time` on one core (~10 min).

idle_reference.note: measured with 3 of my own processes and little other load; probable lower bound

cost.row_overhead_note: row_overhead_ms = S.jpop per fitted row (measured 2.5 ms); episode_fixed_s = reference scale + live mask + projection floor per episode (measured ~1.8 s)
cost.tune_note: tune_cell_episode_s = full hyperparameter grid (12 M1 + 96 M2 candidates, incl. J_pop rows) on ONE episode in ONE (k, noise) cell: measured 0.9-5.8 s (mean 3.0), 0 non-converged of 864 fits, max single fit 0.86 s (2 episodes x 4 cells, wind 4)

worst_pool.note: control (a'): worst = highest design-stage (dyn_opt) surrogate risk among the 16 layouts of the cell + 500 random k-subsets (rng [pool_layouts, k]); asserted >= 1.5 x pool median before tuning, else stop.

control_b.note: control (b'): two groups of 10 random layouts (replicate indices 100+i and 200+i of the design-layout stream), two-level bootstrap; criterion must NOT be met in any cell.

bootstrap.note: two-level (layout x episode) for dyn_opt-vs-random and control (b'); episode bootstrap for single-layout contrasts ('this layout only'); level = 0.05/(|ks| x |noise| x |baselines|) = 0.0025.
